entities.name: Nikola Nestorović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikola Nestorović was a Serbian architect and professor at the Technical Faculty. He is one of the most important architects in Serbia, whose creativity marked and enriched Belgrade and Serbian architecture during the last decade of the nineteenth and the first decade of the twentieth century.
